Package models.academic

Class Schedule

java.lang.Object
models.academic.Schedule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Schedule extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a weekly schedule of lessons. Supports room-load awareness to avoid double-booking rooms. (Bonus feature: Schedule generation taking into account room load and room type.)
